name: Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Warm the olive oil, add the garlic, then stir in the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Toss the drained spaghetti through the sauce and finish with fresh basil.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Cook the fettuccine in salted water until al dente, reserving a mug of pasta water.
Saute the mushrooms until golden, then add the garlic and cook for one minute.
Stir in the cream and parmesan, loosen with pasta water, and toss with the fettuccine.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken
steps: Coat the chicken with lemon zest, juice, garlic, oregano, and olive oil.
Sear the chicken in an ovenproof pan for three minutes on each side.
Bake at 200 C for 18 to 20 minutes, then rest for five minutes before serving.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry the carrot and peas over high heat until just tender.
Push the vegetables aside, scramble the eggs in the pan, then mix everything together.
Add the chilled rice and soy sauce and stir-fry until piping hot.

name: Red Lentil Curry
steps: Soften the onion in a large saucepan, then stir in the curry powder for one minute.
Add the lentils, coconut milk, tomatoes, and 250 ml of water.
Simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend the bananas, oats, eggs, milk, and baking powder into a smooth batter.
Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over medium heat.
Cook small ladlefuls for two minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

name: Roasted Vegetable Tray Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 210 C and spread the vegetables over a large roasting tray.
Drizzle with olive oil, season, and toss until evenly coated.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until browned and tender.

name: Apple Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 190 C and arrange the apples in a baking dish with half the sugar and the cinnamon.
Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the remaining sugar to make a coarse crumble.
Scatter the topping over the apples and bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.
